sayLines.text: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Grief Counselor is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

🔥 Hannah takes up a brand and Santiago follows — they meet it at the edge of the light with noise and fire. Grief Counselor was never brave. It melts back into the dark. (The watch drove off the feast's scavenger. The devotion stays armed; the feast's fire still burns in you.)
